The existing default paired codec creates the opaque identity only after authentic decoding, genuine opened PostgreSQL ownership, live admission membership and genuine current default broker proof. Copies, structural SQL handles, native absence, isolated test custody and wrong bytes cannot issue it. A private async invocation cell expires in `finally`; detached children cannot keep it. The hold transaction uses existing exact plan/source/product/current policy and consumed human-round predicates. It commits independently before returning counted unresolved history. The workspace coordinator serializes transitions and supplies no authorization. Exact immutable project/environment scope can remain unrelated; a missing scope checks any workspace hold. Changed promoted scope must equal the original proposal scope before any transition. No new operation or lease lock occurs after coordinator acquisition. Native INSERT FK locks are acquired first; owner grant INSERT reuses its transaction's already held operation and hold locks.

Only the active authenticated destroy attempt can reserve one JTI, capability and worker audience. Reservation is committed before signing.
